watches.name: Gongque-JH0601G Guilloché
watches.description: The guilloché dial of the “JIANGHUN Gongque” draws inspiration from classical Chinese palace architecture and ancient waterway engineering.The dial is divided into two distinct sections. At the center, overlapping curved cuts form a dense geometric pattern, offering an abstract interpretation of the layered structures found in traditional palace architecture. The varying depth of the cuts gives the surface a strong sense of dimension, while the changing angles catch the light as the watch moves.Surrounding the center is a clean white ring, inspired by the white stone balustrades and foundations found in classical Chinese architecture. Beyond it, the outer dial features a horizontal ripple pattern, referencing the movement of water and the way sunlight shimmers across its surface.The two sections are cut at different angles, giving each pattern its own character under light. The central guilloché creates a more concentrated, radial reflection, while the outer ripples produce a softer, horizontal sheen. As the watch moves on the wrist, these reflections shift continuously across the dial, revealing the depth and contrast between the two patterns.

watches.name: Xuanwu
watches.description: JH04 "Xuanwu" Series marks JIANGHUN Watch's continued exploration into the essence of traditional culture. "Xuanwu", one of the Four Symbols, embodies unwavering resilience, comprehensive protection, and long-lasting health and vitality. The design of the JH0401 diver watch perfectly mirrors these qualities: balanced proportions and subtle details instill the timepiece with a unique and enduring presence.The JH0401 diver captivates with its clear, well-arranged dial and carefully considered lines, establishing a distinct and strong identity. Drawing deeply on the tenets of Chinese watchmaking, it incorporates original design elements that showcase JIANGHUN Watch’s commitment to thoughtful craftsmanship. Every detail tells a story of Oriental horology.The development of this model was significantly enhanced by the collaboration with a long-time supporter of the brand, Professor Li from Sichuan University. The focus of this partnership was the refinement of visual balance and the relationship between each design element. The result is a refined timepiece that conveys both profound cultural meaning and distinctive character.As the premiere piece of the JH04 series, the JH0401 perfectly demonstrates how JIANGHUN Watch combines symbolic inspiration with practical aesthetics. It is not only a reliable companion crafted for divers and collectors but also a powerful statement of the brand's approach to innovation in Chinese watch design.Instruction Manual （PDF）

watches.name: Deep Challenger-JH0203G-Chronograph Diver 300 Type
watches.description: As a new addition to the JIANGHUN Watch Deep Challenger series, the JH0203 stays true to its diver-focused origins while introducing mechanical chronograph functionality. Built for those who demand both strength and precision, it merges tool-watch utility with a bold, uncompromising presence.Powered by the China Peacock SL4801 automatic chronograph movement, the JH0203 features a classic 3-6-9 subdial layout and screw-down pushers for added protection. The case—crafted from solid 316L stainless steel—offers both rugged durability and all-day wearability, backed by a dependable 300-meter water resistance rating suited for serious dive conditions.The JH0203 retains the series’ defining elements: clear legibility, robust proportions, and a confident silhouette. Purposeful in design and unapologetically mechanical, it delivers real-world functionality without losing its distinctive character.Instruction Manual （PDF）

It symbolizes the unique mark each of us leaves in this vast universe. The dial itself feels like an entryway to another world—where time is not only measured but experienced.Instruction Manual （PDF）

watches.name: War Drum-JH0106GJ 42mm
watches.description: JH0106 Chronograph – The Mechanical Echo of the War DrumAs the latest extension of the JH01 War Drum series, the JH0106 Chronograph blends tactical aesthetics with refined mechanical performance. Inspired by the solid and rhythmic form of traditional war drums, the round case design emphasizes strength, balance, and commanding presence—true to the collection’s core identity.Powered by the Peacock SL-4801 mechanical chronograph movement, the JH0106 offers precise stopwatch functionality within a well-organized tri-compax dial layout. The matte dial is framed by a contrasting sand-beige inner ring, creating visual depth and vintage appeal. Three sub-dials echo the beat of a drum, while red chronograph accents introduce dynamic movement.The oversized onion crown and pronounced pushers not only enhance operability. Combined with the robust lugs and padded leather strap, the watch achieves a distinct balance of force and form.Whether timing your run or appreciating the beat of craftsmanship, the JH0106 is not just a timepiece—it’s the rhythm of precision, forged in steel.Instruction Manual （PDF）

watches.name: War Drum
watches.description: This new GMT model builds upon the 46mm version of the JH01 Battle Drum Series, continuing its bold visual identity while adding practical functionality for those who frequently cross time zones. As part of JIANGHUN Watch, a young and original name in the world of Chinese watches, this design reflects a growing emphasis on both aesthetics and purpose.The dial takes inspiration from the Earth itself—latitude and longitude lines intersect to form a structured, almost architectural 3D effect, bringing to mind a miniature globe in motion. The hands are carefully shaped, with subtle curves at their tips to match the flow of the spherical design and improve readability at a glance.With a 46mm case, a 52.5mm lug-to-lug length, and a 13.6mm thickness, the watch maintains the substantial presence that defines the series, while 10 bar water resistance allows it to adapt to daily wear and travel alike.As part of the broader JIANGHUN Watch family, it reflects a shared commitment to originality and mechanical substance—Don’t follow the crowd. Define extraordinary craftsmanship.Instruction Manual （PDF）
